sources.revision: Mutable main branch; public README reviewed 2026-10-20, no immutable commit resolved

sources.evidenceCeiling: Project documentation is not an executed capability result, immutable artifact, production-consumer qualification, or ACIS semantic witness.

sources.revision: Mutable main branch; public source reviewed 2026-10-20, no immutable commit resolved

sources.evidenceCeiling: The reviewed exchange code is a faceted projection route and does not preserve analytic ACIS surfaces, trims, or exact ACIS record/body identity. The screen found no documented DWG, DXF, SAT/SAB, ACIS, or AcDs reader.

sources.observed: The plan already separates carrier parse, typed-record closure, AcDs source-owner association, topology transfer, independent analytic expectations, and native consumer qualification; NVIDIA SMLib is already recorded as a conditional kernel-only candidate.
sources.evidenceCeiling: This reconciliation is a candidate admission decision only. It does not provide new peer results or alter the deferred external qualification gates.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: reject optional peer candidates before build/adapter work when immutable provenance, exact input profile, or required analytic/topological representation is missing
assessment.planImpact: Record brep-kernel as SCREENED_NOT_ADMITTED for the ACIS semantic route: its reviewed STEP/IGES exchange is faceted, no immutable revision was pinned, and no ACIS/DWG/DXF reader was documented. Do not clone/build, add a dependency, or write an adapter for this task. Keep the candidate available only for a future separately specified triangulated-topology question.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source documentation and source review; local plan-only update
